scope: new universal image optimized from random initialization, then SafeBench-only evaluation
profile: official executable implementation with paper's 1300 update count
gradient_accumulation: sum, one Adam step after all 50 rows
initialization: torch.rand(3,224,224), float32, no existing attack image

execution.model_parameters: frozen; gradients computed only for image
execution.input_cache: deterministic original process_target tensors; parity checked before full run
execution.diagnostic_generation: omitted; no effect on loss or update rule, changes RNG consumption relative to unseeded upstream run
execution.checkpoint: image, Adam and Python/NumPy/Torch/CUDA RNG after each completed update
execution.final_selection: fixed final update 1300, no selection using held-out ASR

limitations: This follows the released executable math with the paper's update count; discrepancies are recorded in paper_code_audit.json
No author-provided seed or exact training checkpoint for the released image
CUDA kernels may be numerically nondeterministic
Official response extraction includes prompt text; assistant-only scores are also reported
